steps.content: [Downtown]

Your deduction about the new Mania variant is correct. The recent confrontation has provided reliable information. The shackles could sense that it was indeed all transformed from the malice brought by the Gray Mirror votes. As soon as you're out of the TV station, you immediately send the intelligence back to the Bureau.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Just as you predicted, the number of votes has started to surge. I'll coordinate with the Public Security Bureau for more manpower. Chief, you should rest for a bit.
You shrug, deliberately lightening your tone.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The internet won't let me off easily. My votes will continue to fluctuate near the Purge line. Expect to see similar battles frequently. Our goal is to draw out the most powerful Mania force within Gray Mirror and trace back to the <color=#fb9259>source of the contamination</color>.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I just came out of the TV station on the Fifth Avenue. I'll quickly find an empty spot and wait for our tech department and the Public Security Bureau to join me, so that Purge attempts against me won't cause a panic among the public.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If our colleagues are really worried about me, why don't they sneak onto Gray Mirror and cast a few Perfect votes for me or say a few good words?
Your not-so-clever joke actually works this time, lifting the spirits of your colleagues. If they can find out the source of contamination with this renewed vigor, it will end all of this.

What is this source of contamination capable of effortlessly evading its pursuers while carrying such massive energy? A rampaging Sinner? A new toy of the Undergrounders? Or can the source of the digitalized Mania travel at light speed as codes, like in a sci-fi movie? Perhaps you'll find out soon.
While you're walking and considering various extraordinary possibilities...

steps.speaker: Passerby
steps.content: Ah... Excuse me!
A passerby engrossed by her phone accidentally bumps into you, and before you can tell her it's okay, she exclaims in surprise.

steps.speaker: Passerby
steps.content: Gray coat and gray hair!

steps.speaker: Passerby
steps.content: You, you wouldn't happen to be that... Exterminator, would you?
How can she still recognize you after Bianca wrapped you up like that? It's probably just a guess?

options: Is this Exterminator some kind of celebrity?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: No way, I saw it on the internet too. Come on, I look nothing like that bulky Exterminator, do I? The only thing we have in common is the gray clothes.

steps.speaker: Passerby
steps.content: Ah, I see... Sorry about that.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Oh no, you caught me! Yes, that's me!
It's pointless to deny the suspicion. You're probably better off just playing dumb.

steps.speaker: Passerby
steps.content: Ah, I see... Glad to meet you...
She chuckles nervously and scurries away, picking up her phone again.
